questions.text:
The maximum number of super keys for the relation schema R (E, F, G, H) with E as the key
is __________.
questions.solution:
A super key must contain E. The other attributes F, G, H may or may not be included.

[latex]2^3=8[/latex] super keys.

Answer: 8

questions.text:
Which one of the following is TRUE about the interior gateway routing protocols - Routing
Information Protocol (RIP) and Open Shortest Path First (OSPF)?
questions.solution:
RIP shares distance vectors with neighbours (Bellman-Ford). OSPF floods link-state advertisements and runs Dijkstra.

Answer: RIP uses distance vector routing and OSPF uses link state routing

Click here for detail solution by gateoverflow
options: RIP uses distance vector routing and OSPF uses link state routing
OSPF uses distance vector routing and RIP uses link state routing
Both RIP and OSPF use link state routing
Both RIP and OSPF use distance vector routing

questions.text:
Which one of the following socket API functions converts an unconnected active TCP socket
into a passive socket?
questions.solution:
Checking each statement:
- connect: active open to a server
- bind: attaches a local address/port
- listen: marks the socket as passive (ready to accept connections) [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] True
- accept: takes a connection from an already-listening socket

Answer: listen

questions.text: In the diagram shown below, L1 is an Ethernet LAN and L2 is a Token-Ring LAN. An IP packet originates from sender S and traverses to R, as shown. The links within each ISP and across the two ISPs, are all point-to-point' optical links. The initial value of the TTL field is 32. The maximum possible value of the TTL field when R receives the datagram is ____________.
questions.solution:
TTL is decremented only by routers (layer 3). The bridges/switches inside LAN L1 and the stations on token ring L2 work at layer 2 and do not touch TTL.

Following the path, the datagram passes through 6 routers (the square boxes).

TTL at R = 32 [latex]-[/latex] 6 = 26

Answer: 26
